concept: A signing path that accepts any instruction type lets a role with a small token limit change who controls an account without touching its balance.
scene: Dark navy technical card. A simple diagram of a wallet signing call passing a SetAuthority instruction through a balance-only permission check, with ownership of a token account shifting to a second key while the balance stays flat. Clean lines, amber highlight on the bypassed check, white labels.
